Post 1

📉 ASX 200 hit a 100-day high then gave it straight back. Index closed at 8,967.70, down 70.90pts or 0.78%. Materials led the retreat. Five-day gain still sits at 1.46% — but today's reversal stings. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔻 Materials worst sector, -1.59%. Consumer Discretionary -1.39%, A-REITs -0.99%. Only two sectors finished green: IT +0.91%, Energy +0.32%. Breadth was ugly — ten of eleven sectors in the red. #ASX #ausbiz #materials

Post 3

📈 DMP surged 9.08% to AUD 19.59 — best in the index. WiseTech added 6.67% to AUD 37.89. Both bucked the selloff hard. IT was the only sector holding ground, and these two names drove it. #ASX #ausbiz #tech

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,823.51/oz. Silver AUD 82.76/oz. Platinum AUD 2,365.10/oz. With materials off 1.59% today, metal prices alone weren't enough to rescue miners. AUD/USD at 0.6947. #ASX #gold #metals #ausbiz

Post 5

ASX sits 2.56% off its 52-week high after today's fade from a 100-day peak. Can bulls reclaim 9,000? Watch overnight US moves and materials commodity pricing. Where do you see the index by Friday close? #ASX #ausbiz #trading
